title: GenAI Project Manager
full_description:
Following ING’s strategic ambition to deliver a superior experience to its customers worldwide, the hubs network contributes to fostering efficiency and digitalization across ING. Providing concentrated expertise along with scalable and sustainable solutions, the hubs focus on straight-through processing, delivering automated services like software development, data management and retail operations.

ING Hubs Turkiye core capabilities, 𝐑𝐞𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐥 𝐀𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐲𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡, have us looking for data experts, developers and other professionals to get onboard in our Istanbul office located in Technopark, Vadistanbul.
Think Forward! Our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and in business. We are an industry recognized strong brand with positive recognition from customers in many countries, a strong financial position, Omni-channel distribution strategy and international network. If you want to work at a place where we believe that you can make a difference by using the latest Analytics techniques to generate data-driven approaches and conversational products and solve real business challenges, please read on.
ING Analytics is a new unit responsible for realizing this vision for ING, differentiating ING as a leader in data-driven organization, within the banking sector and beyond. The team consists of a number of Global Analytics Centre of Excellences around the bank’s key capabilities (such as Pricing, Risk Management, Financial Crime, Customer Intelligence and People Analytics.) as well as strong coordination areas around data management, technology, customer journey, UX, as well as external partnerships.
You will be part of the Analytics Tribe COO which delivers advanced analytics & artificial intelligence capabilities to all ING countries. Customer Dialogue Analytics at ING joins a global, multidisciplinary analytics team focused on improving chat and voice bots, implementing advanced analytics and AI, and enhancing customer experiences across all ING countries. In this role, you support the development and delivery of data-driven solutions for dialogue systems, bridge business and IT needs, and contribute to designing and implementing Conversational AI products.
You support the development, implementation and communication of the roadmap
You help the product owner manage and prioritize the backlog at the level of user stories, derived from features, epics and technical capabilities
You help define business requirements for the development of products and services in the Conversational (Generative) AI scope
You work with your team to build and manage products with an end-to-end mindset, including design, implementation and operations
You understand client needs, digitization and API’s, bridging IT and business together
You have analytical skills and take decisions based on data and facts
You are a pro-active thinker
You work with Risk, Compliance, Model Risk Management and Legal stakeholders, to make sure our products and services comply with regulations and policies
You are creative and an out-of-the box thinker who likes to work in a multidisciplinary team in an agile environment
Work with the product owner, to prioritize tasks according to the business needs
Build and maintain relationship with third party vendors. This also means that you are capable to drive next generation products together with the product owner.
Bachelor’s with analytical background, preferably in a quantitative discipline Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, MIS, Statistics etc. (Master’s degree or PhD will be a plus),
Minimal 5 years of working experience in applying analytics in a business environment
Professional working language proficiency in English. Dutch/French/Spanish/German are a plus
Familiarity with Agile Scrum way of working
Experience with Conversational AI is a plus
You have excellent oral and written communication skills at the technical and business level
To be able to influence and convince stakeholders based on analytical results
To be analytical: extremely curious, constantly looking for an explanation; analyzing sharply, concise & to the point
Managing product roadmaps and backlogs, defining business requirements, working with internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring compliance
What We Offer at ING Hubs Turkiye
At ING Hubs Turkiye, we believe that your work should be fulfilling in every way. We pay attention to even the smallest details to ensure that your experience is rewarding. Here’s what you can expect when you join our organization:
Be Yourself, Be an ING'er
Dynamic Environment:Work in an informal, vibrant atmosphere with innovative colleagues supporting your endeavors.
Innovation Culture:Share your innovative ideas while exploring PACE methodology with us.
Global Exposure:Participate in global projects and expand your career opportunities.
Communication & Celebrations:Enjoy various communication activities and celebrations that promote a friendly work environment.
Health Care:Your health matters; we offer a comprehensive health insurance package for you and your loved ones, including spouse and children.
Private Pension Plan:Secure your future dreams with our private pension plan.
If you want to do your thing and explore the life while working don’t miss this opportunity!
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
